message.content:
A digital illustration shows two men from the waist up behind a miniature construction site built from toy blocks. The man on the left holds a green block over a grey dam structure, while the man on the right holds a red block and looks toward a yellow block in his other hand. Both men wear light-colored short-sleeved shirts.

The foreground contains a grey dam with several vertical supports. Construction vehicles, including a yellow crane, a yellow excavator, a yellow cement mixer, and a yellow dump truck carrying grey cylinders, sit on a green baseplate. Scattered across this baseplate are small green trees and loose toy bricks.

Behind the dam, various colorful block-built structures resemble buildings and industrial plants with tall stacks. A crane on the left lifts a grey rectangular block. Above the men, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large red letters. A small blue and white helicopter is positioned near the "T". A barcode, QR code, and text including "Duet Maut," "Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan," and "Boy Thohir" are also visible.
